Title: Azure Database for MySQL—Service health notifications in East US and UK South

Body.Content:
Now in preview for the East US and UK South regions only, Azure Database for MySQL provides support for service health notifications for planned maintenance. Taking advantage of this feature allows you to view all planned maintenance for the services in your subscription in one place. Set up service health alerts to notify you when there are issues or changes that may affect the Azure services and regions you use.

Read more about creating activity log alerts for service health notifications in our service documentation.


Customers in the East US and UK South regions are encouraged to try this feature and provide feedback in the forum or directly to the Azure Database for MySQL team.
